Supported directory variables

support.google.com/chrome/a/answer/9866158?hl=en
As an admin, you can use variables to configure file paths, such as the directory that Chrome uses for storing user data. That way, you don't need to set a hard-coded path. For example, to store profile data under the user local application data on Windows, set the UserDataDir policy to $ {local_app_data}\Chrome\Profile.
